title: Rose McGowan's lawsuit against Harvey Weinstein dismissed
summary: A federal judge has dismissed a lawsuit filed by actress Rose McGowan alleging that Harvey Weinstein engaged in racketeering to silence her and derail her career before she accused him of rape.

title: First look at Austin thrill ride's safety measures after deadly Florida accident
summary: In response to a KXAN investigation, the Circuit of The Americas' theme park, COTALAND, allowed KXAN to see up close and document the safety steps in place at its nearly 200-foot-tall drop tower, Downforce. The thrill ride, as we previously reported, was manufactured by the same foreign company found negligent in the 2022 death of 14-year-old Tyre Sampson in Orlando, Florida.

title: Texas State University students protest, demand stronger free speech protections
summary: Dozens of Texas State University students gathered for a funeral-themed protest, calling for stronger protections for free speech and academic freedom on campus.

title: Audit on Austin's city-issued credit cards sparks policy updates
summary: The recent report found the number of cards given to employees increases the risk for fraud.

title: Austin ISD asks for donations to help support student meal accounts in need
summary: The Austin Independent School District is asking for donations to help continue to support students, who may have a negative meal account and are not enrolled in the free or reduced price meal program.
